benefits: Under this scheme, employment generation is promoted through entrepreneurship development in the small ruminants, poultry, piggery, and the fodder sector.
detailed_description: The scheme “Entrepreneurship Development Scheme”, a sub-component of the National Livestock Mission, is implemented by the Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board (ULDB) under the Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote employment generation through entrepreneurship development in the small ruminants, poultry, piggery, and the fodder sectors by providing financial and institutional support to individuals and organized groups under the National Livestock Mission.
eligibility: The applicant must belong to one of the following eligible categories: - Individual Entrepreneur - Self Help Group (SHG) - Farmer Producer Organization (FPO) - Farmers Cooperative (FCO) - Joint Liability Group (JLG) - Section 8 Company
